description: Generate installation code for a specific framework and placement strategy

existingElement.description: Existing element details (for "existing" placement). Accepts either a CSS selector or a feedback element object from issuecapture_analyze.

file.description: Source file path where the element was found

line.description: Line number where the element was found

selector.description: CSS selector to use as trigger (e.g. "#feedback")

framework.description: Framework type. Vue, Angular, Svelte, and other frameworks use vanilla JavaScript fallback.

projectRoot.description: Optional absolute path to the project root. If provided, the generator can tailor file paths to your structure (e.g. src/app vs app).

name: issuecapture_generate
